item.title: Supercharged 1997 BMW M3 Coupe 5-Speed
item.description: This 1997 BMW M3 coupe has been modified with Dinan S3-package modifications including a Vortech V-2 Si-trim supercharger, engine software, a throttle body, and a muffler, along with Dinan springs and strut tower brace. It rides on 17" forged Style 24 wheels and has been further modified with a ZHP-specification steering rack, a Lightweight-style wing, European-style headlights, aftermarket bucket seats, and a Kenwood stereo. item.title: 350-Powered 1956 Ford F-100 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1956 Ford F-100 pickup was the subject of a custom build under prior ownership that involved the installation of a Chevrolet 350ci V8, a TH350 three-speed automatic transmission, and a 10-bolt rear end as well as an independent front suspension assembly from a later GM passenger car. item.title: 44k-Mile 2007 Cadillac DTS Luxury II at No Reserve
item.description: This 2007 Cadillac DTS has 44k miles following history in California since new. It was ordered with the Luxury II Package, which specified heated, cooled, and massaging front seats as well as a heated steering wheel, Bose audio, tri-zone climate control, remote start, parking sensors, and heated rear seats. item.title: 1991 Alfa Romeo Spider Veloce
item.description: This 1991 Alfa Romeo Spider Veloce has spent most of its time registered in California, and 75k of the 134k miles shown have been added since the current owner purchased the car in December 1995. It is finished in Alfa Red over beige leather and suede and is powered by a 2.0-liter inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transmission. item.title: 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Z11 Pace Car Convertible 396 4-Speed
item.description: This 1969 Chevrolet Camaro convertible is equipped with the Z11 option, which added the RS and SS packages as well as trim and decals in the style of the Camaro pace car used at the 1969 Indianapolis 500. The car is said to have been refurbished under prior ownership and is powered by a 396ci V8 linked with a four-speed manual transmission and a 12-bolt rear end. item.title: RoW 1985 Porsche 911 Carrera Targa G50 RUF BTR III Conversion
item.description: This RoW 1985 Porsche 911 Carrera Targa was brought to RUF of Pfaffenhausen, Germany and converted to their BTR III specification in 1990 before being imported to the US the following year. It is said to have remained with its original owner until 2024 and subsequently underwent a refurbishment, including a repaint, a refresh of the interior and suspension, an overhaul of the brakes, and rebuilds of the engine and transaxle. item.title: 1982 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ43 by FJ Company
item.description: This 1982 Land Cruiser FJ43 was refurbished and modified by the FJ Company in Colombia before it was imported to the US, and it was sold on BaT in November of 2022 before it was purchased by the current owner in 2024. Built to the FJ Company’s G43-S specification, the truck is finished in Grayish Olive over red leather and is powered by a supercharged 4.0-liter Toyota 1GR-FE V6 mated to a five-speed manual transmission and a dual-range transfer case. item.title: 2,900-Mile 2001 BMW Z8
item.description: This 2001 BMW Z8 has 2,900 miles following registration history in California, Florida, and Montana, and it was purchased by its current owner in September 2022. The car is finished in Titanium Silver Metallic over black Nappa leather and is powered by 4.9-liter V8 paired with a six-speed manual transmission. item.title: 1971 Mercedes-Benz 280SE 3.5 Coupe
item.description: This 1971 Mercedes-Benz 280SE 3.5 coupe is one of approximately 3,270 examples produced between 1969 and 1971, and it was first owned in California. The car is finished in Blue Metallic over parchment leather and is powered by a 3.5-liter V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes 14" steel wheels with covers, disc brakes, US-specification headlights, three-point seat belts, power windows, an AM/FM stereo, and air conditioning. item.title: 2k-Mile 2015 Porsche 918 Spyder Weissach Package
item.description: This 2015 Porsche 918 Spyder is #221 of 918 examples built and was delivered new in California. The car is said to be one of four finished in Guards Red for the North American market that was factory equipped with the Weissach Package. It is powered by a 4.6-liter V8 that works in conjunction with dual electric motors that drive all four wheels through a seven-speed PDK automatic transaxle.
